deck_surface_input_groups.description: Same multi-component input structure as NC deck spec. Floor SF, railing LF, spindle EA, stair EA.

task_production_rates.name: Siding Protection at Ledger Board
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC deck spec. ~36 sec per LF. Tape at siding-to-deck transition, hang plastic for spray method.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage of siding face. No gaps at ledger board transition.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Protection Below Deck
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~18 sec per SF. Deploy tarps below elevated deck.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage below deck footprint. Tarps secured.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Adjacent to Deck
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~14 sec per SF. Drop cloths on adjacent walkways.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage within overspray zone.

task_production_rates.name: Deck Furniture Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~30 min average. Move furniture off deck surface.

defect_tolerance.all: All items relocated. Clear working surface.

task_production_rates.name: Deck Light Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~8-9 min per fixture. Bag and tape.

defect_tolerance.all: All fixtures fully bagged and sealed.

task_production_rates.name: Existing Coating Condition Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Visual assessment of existing coating across all components. Rate condition per component. Document wear patterns, adhesion failure zones, mildew. ~45 min for standard deck. Less than trim RP assess (90 min) because deck has fewer component types.

defect_tolerance.all: All components assessed. Condition documented per component.

task_production_rates.name: Existing Coating Type Identification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Solvent wipe test at multiple locations. Denatured alcohol dissolves latex, mineral spirits dissolve oil-based. ~20 min per project.

defect_tolerance.all: Coating type identified per component. Unknown treated as incompatible.

task_production_rates.name: ASTM D3359 Adhesion Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Cross-hatch adhesion test on film-forming coatings only (solid stain, paint). Minimum 3 locations per component. ~25 min per project. Not applicable for penetrating stains.

defect_tolerance.all: Adhesion scored per location. <=3B triggers strip.

task_production_rates.name: Deck Moisture Content Testing
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. Pin-type MC meter, multiple points. MC >15% HARD STOP. ~20 min.

defect_tolerance.all: All readings below threshold. Wet spots flagged.

task_production_rates.name: Rot Probe at Vulnerable Locations
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Probe stair treads, post bases, railing joints, board ends. ~20 min. Rot = hard stop for affected component.

defect_tolerance.all: All vulnerable locations probed. Rot documented.

task_production_rates.name: Light Scuff Sand — Sound/Worn Existing
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Light scuff sand (80-100 grit) to degloss existing coating. ~45 sec per SF. Faster than NC mill glaze sand (50 SF/hr) because existing coating just needs degloss, not aggressive removal. Orbital sander, light pass.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform degloss. No deep scratches. Wear-through edges blended.

task_production_rates.name: Heavy Sand — Post-Strip Residual Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Aggressive 60-grit sanding after chemical strip to remove residual coating and smooth raised grain. ~90 sec per SF. Slower than light sand — more material removal and deeper grain profile restoration. Belt sander or aggressive orbital.

defect_tolerance.all: All residual coating removed. Raised grain smoothed. Clean wood exposed.

task_production_rates.name: Pressure Wash Deck Floor
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~9 sec per SF. 1,000-1,500 PSI fan tip. 24-48 hr dry time after.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform clean surface. No pressure damage. 24-48 hr dry before staining.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~24 sec per SF. Apply, dwell, scrub, rinse. Conditional on visible mildew.

defect_tolerance.all: All visible mildew eliminated. Rinse thoroughly.

task_production_rates.name: Post-Wash Dry Verification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. Verify MC <=15% after washing. ~12 min.

defect_tolerance.all: All test points below MC threshold.

task_production_rates.name: Railing System Sanding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Slightly slower than NC (12 LF/hr) because RP requires scuffing existing coating plus scraping any failing areas and feather-sanding edges. ~6 min per LF. Hand sand all surfaces.

defect_tolerance.all: All railing surfaces sanded. Loose coating scraped. Edges feathered.

task_production_rates.name: Spindle/Baluster Sanding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Slightly slower than NC (12 EA/hr) for same reason — existing coating scuffing. ~6 min per spindle. Hand sand all 4 sides.

defect_tolerance.all: All spindle surfaces sanded. Existing coating scuffed for adhesion.

task_production_rates.name: Railing System Wash
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~2 min per LF. Low-pressure wash, not high-pressure.

defect_tolerance.all: All railing surfaces clean. Allow dry time.

task_production_rates.name: Chemical Stripper Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~13 sec per SF. Pump sprayer application of alkaline stripper.

defect_tolerance.all: Even application. No dry spots. Working sections defined.

task_production_rates.name: Stripper Dwell Time
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. 15-20 min dwell per manufacturer spec.

defect_tolerance.all: Dwell per spec. Surface kept wet.

task_production_rates.name: Stripper Agitation/Scrub
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~24 sec per SF. Stiff bristle brush agitation. RP may require more aggressive scrubbing for multi-layer existing.

defect_tolerance.all: All sections scrubbed. Old coating visibly loosening.

task_production_rates.name: Stripper Rinse
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~9 sec per SF. Pressure rinse to remove chemical residue.

defect_tolerance.all: All chemical residue removed. Clean wood visible.

task_production_rates.name: Wood Brightener Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~13 sec per SF. Pump sprayer application of acid brightener.

defect_tolerance.all: Even application. Wood color visibly brightening.

task_production_rates.name: Brightener Dwell Time
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. 10-15 min dwell.

defect_tolerance.all: Dwell per spec. Uniform color change.

task_production_rates.name: Brightener Rinse
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~9 sec per SF. 24-48 hr dry time required after.

defect_tolerance.all: All brightener residue removed. Surface pH neutral.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Restain — Spray + Back-Brush (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. 275 SF/hr per 2-person crew. Back-brushing MANDATORY. Once prepped, application rate is surface-history-independent.

defect_tolerance.all: Even penetration. No pooling. Back-brushed within 30 sec. Consistent color.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Restain — Brush Application (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~29 sec per SF. 4-inch stain brush.

defect_tolerance.all: Even penetration. Consistent color. Wet edge maintained.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Restain — Pad Applicator (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~14 sec per SF. Lamb's wool pad on pole.

defect_tolerance.all: Even application. No pad marks. Wet edge maintained.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Restain — Roller Application (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~18 sec per SF. Best for solid stain film-build.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage. No roller marks. No pooling between boards.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Restain — Second Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1. Rate shown is spray_backbrush baseline — actual follows selected method. All RP coating types get 2 coats (stripped/weathered wood absorbs more).

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage over first coat. Consistent color depth.

task_production_rates.name: Railing Restain — Spray + Back-Brush (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~5 min per LF per 2-person crew.

defect_tolerance.all: All railing surfaces coated. Back-brushed. No runs on posts.

task_production_rates.name: Railing Restain — Brush Application (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~6 min per LF.

defect_tolerance.all: All surfaces coated. No brush marks. No runs.

task_production_rates.name: Spindle Restain — Spray (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~4 min per spindle. Spray from multiple angles.

defect_tolerance.all: All 4 sides coated. No drips.

task_production_rates.name: Spindle Restain — Brush (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~6 min per spindle.

defect_tolerance.all: All surfaces coated. No drips.

task_production_rates.name: Railing Restain — Second Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage. Consistent color depth. No runs.

task_production_rates.name: Spindle Restain — Second Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage on all sides.

task_production_rates.name: Stair Step Restain — Brush (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~20 min per step. Alternating step pattern. Includes end-grain sealing.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage. End grain sealed. Alternating pattern maintained.

task_production_rates.name: Stair Step Restain — Second Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage. End grain fully sealed.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~20 min. Walk entire deck checking all components.

defect_tolerance.all: Complete inspection. No missed spots.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Restaining
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~48 sec per SF. Rate per total floor SF — most area passes without touch-up.

defect_tolerance.all: All defects repaired. Touch-ups blended.

task_production_rates.name: Furniture Return
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~22 min. Verify surface dry before placing.

defect_tolerance.all: All items returned. No damage to fresh stain.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~20 min. Remove all protection materials.

defect_tolerance.all: All protection removed. No tape residue.

task_production_rates.name: Tool and Equipment Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same as NC. ~17 min. Flush sprayer, clean brushes, dispose chemicals.

defect_tolerance.all: All tools cleaned. Chemicals disposed.

factor_modifiers.name: Coating Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: PRIMARY configuration dimension. Inherited from NC. Affects APPLICATION tasks only.
factor_modifiers.notes: Same values as NC minus clear_sealer (excluded from RP). Semi_transparent baseline.

factor_modifiers.name: Existing Coating Condition Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: RP-SPECIFIC. Replaces NC's FAC_DECK_WOOD_CONDITION. Drives prep intensity based on existing coating state. Sound = light prep, peeling = full strip.
factor_modifiers.notes: Sound = intact existing coating, just degloss and recoat. Worn = traffic wear areas need blending, moderate prep. Failing = widespread adhesion loss, chemical strip needed (1.60x). Peeling = sheet delamination, aggressive strip + extra sanding (2.00x). Applies to PREP tasks only.

factor_modifiers.name: Wood Substrate Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Inherited from NC unchanged. Affects both prep and application.
factor_modifiers.notes: Same as NC. PT pine baseline.

quality_effects.description: Deck RP uses coating_type as primary dimension. All RP coating types get 2 coats (stripped/weathered wood absorbs more).

semi_transparent.notes: Two coats of semi-transparent stain. Wet-on-absorbing for penetrating stains.

semi_solid.notes: Two coats of semi-solid stain. Slight film-build.

solid_stain.notes: Two coats of solid stain. Film-forming — inspect between coats. DELAMINATION RISK WARNING.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: PT pine, semi-transparent, sound existing — best case RP floor (spray_backbrush)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Best case — same as NC baseline. Sound existing means minimal prep overhead.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Redwood, solid stain, peeling existing — worst case PREP (heavy sand)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Worst case prep — peeling redwood deck. 17 SF/hr. Very slow but realistic for stripping multi-layer solid stain from softwood.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Redwood, solid stain, peeling — worst case APPLICATION
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Worst case application — solid stain on redwood. 191 SF/hr. Existing condition does NOT affect application rate (prep normalizes surface).

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Maximum stacking check — solid stain x peeling x redwood (if all applied to same task)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: 2.88x — under 4.0x cap. In practice, existing_condition only applies to prep, coating_type only to application, so real stacking is lower.

assumptions: Application base rates identical to NC spec — once prepped, application is surface-history-independent.
RP prep tasks are slower due to existing coating removal overhead — captured by FAC_DKRP_EXISTING_CONDITION.
Light scuff sand rate (80 SF/hr) faster than NC mill glaze sand (50 SF/hr) because degloss is less aggressive than glaze removal.
Heavy sand rate (40 SF/hr) slower than NC sand rates because post-strip residual removal requires more aggressive sanding.
Railing and spindle RP sand rates 15-20% slower than NC due to existing coating scraping overhead.
All RP coating types get 2 coats — stripped/weathered wood absorbs more than new wood.
Clear_sealer excluded from RP coating_type values — maintenance reapplication, not restain scope.
Chemical restoration module (strip/brighten/rinse) reused from NC with same rates. RP may need stronger formulations for multi-layer existing.
Assessment module is RP-specific addition. FIXED time tasks not area-dependent.
No FAC_EXT_ACCESS — deck staining is ground-level work.
Coating compatibility assessment (existing coating type ID) is MANDATORY before committing to re-coating strategy.
FIXED time tasks are not modified by any factor — assessment, dwell times, furniture staging, cleanup.
risks: Solid stain over existing solid stain on horizontal surfaces has compounding delamination risk — each coat adds film thickness. Assessment must include total existing film build measurement.
Unknown existing coating type requires adhesion testing and potentially full strip. 'Unknown' treatment = most conservative (bonding primer or strip).
Multi-layer existing coatings may resist standard chemical strippers — escalation to mechanical stripping not modeled in standard rates.
Previously painted decks (not stained) require full strip before penetrating stain can be applied — paint seals wood surface.
Cedar/redwood tannin bleed can occur even after stripping — brightener treatment and oil-based stain recommended.
validation_plan: Time 3 RP spray_backbrush floor restaining jobs to confirm application rates match NC baseline (275 SF/hr).
Time 2 light scuff sand jobs on sound existing to validate 80 SF/hr rate.
Time 2 heavy sand (post-strip) jobs to validate 40 SF/hr rate.
Track 3 full chemical strip cycles on failing decks to validate strip+brighten+rinse combined time.
Time 2 assessment modules to validate FIXED time ranges (condition + coating ID + adhesion + moisture + rot probe).
Compare RP railing/spindle sand rates vs NC to validate the ~15-20% slower RP adjustment.
Track existing coating condition modifier accuracy: compare actual prep time ratios across sound/worn/failing/peeling decks.
